title: SEO Setup
description: Standard SEO configuration for launch-ready WordPress sites.

steps.title: Set Post Name Permalinks
steps.instructions: Change permalink structure to Post name (/%postname%/).

steps.title: Enable Search Indexing
steps.instructions: Uncheck 'Discourage search engines' in Settings → Reading.

steps.title: Configure XML Sitemap
steps.instructions: Enable and submit XML sitemap to Google Search Console.

steps.title: Install SEO Plugin
steps.instructions: Install Yoast, Rank Math, or similar and configure site title templates.

steps.title: Add Organization Schema
steps.instructions: Configure Organization/LocalBusiness schema with logo and contact info.
